background:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production background plate for a Godot pixel-art game's EARLY-GAME return-to-hearth screen, no UI.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved story composition sheet. Follow ONLY its upper-right panel 02 (the door, pipe coupling and bench location), NOT its final panel 06 handover ending. Image 2 is character identity reference only; do not paint its characters into this background. Image 3 is the actual approved production pixel size, flat materials and restrained cold/warm palette.
Primary request: one single 16:9 landscape pixel background, same fixed high three-quarter orthographic camera and same spatial relationships as story panel 02, reconstructed with clearly legible production pixel clusters. The ruined Winterward Generator is a remnant heating apparatus with chipped bone-grey ceramic shell and dark recovered steel bands, large cylindrical repair coupling sticking left toward a small bone-cloth hearth canopy; cold abandoned technological ruins, sparse snow on upper surfaces, weathered wood, limited warmth, quiet dark slate walkable floor. The visible tower occupies the right half and extends beyond the upper edge; the canopy occupies the upper-left third. The closed vertical warm-slit maintenance door at lower right and the large vulnerable metal coupling left of it must both read clearly. There is a modest cooking brazier under the canopy. Reserve empty ground immediately beside the pipe for a standing worker and in the lower-left for the ranger; no people baked into the background. A wooden bench will be a separate layer, so DO NOT paint any bench, chair or stool. A cloth patch and hand-repaired collar communicate continuing limited heat; DO NOT depict completed restoration or a summer thaw.
Style: truly pixel-art background at 640x360 native resolution, if delivered larger emulate exact uniformly enlarged square pixels from that size, nearest-neighbor sharp contours, restrained 32-color-like cool slate, bone, muted warm wood, old copper, small amber fire. P1 sparse clean ground, few deliberate seams, NO stippling or random grit. No smooth gradient shading, no bloom, no blur, no painterly/photo realism, no glossy 3D modeled look, no micro-noise. Keep deep tech remnants inert and partly closed, subtle purple broken-core magic far up the cropped tower only, not generic magical lighting.
Composition constraints: single scene, no panels, no title, no border, no labels, no text, no watermark, no characters, no NPCs, no benches/chairs. Cool weather remains clearly present. Art fills the entire 16:9 picture, not a tiny isolated diorama on empty paper. This is the early-game RETURN before the ultimate tower repair, not the final E03 warmth/shift-handover milestone.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: three original pixel sprite layers for the approved return-to-hearth scene.
Input image: approved character sheet, identity and clothing reference. Mira is the first resident in the middle row; Leia is the fourth resident. Do not depict ranger/alchemist/mage.
Produce ONE sprite sheet on a genuinely transparent alpha background, exactly three separated columns in ONE row, no labels or cell borders, generous empty gutters:
LEFT: Mira, older practical worker in bone-white small work cap and scarf, muted brown coarse coat, dark grey apron and trousers, dark boots and brown gloves. Full body fixed high three-quarter view facing RIGHT/EAST, leaning slightly toward a heating pipe which is NOT part of this sprite, with both arms reaching forward/up to grip a repair coupling just in front of her chest. A small wrench is held with the forward gloved hand. All hands visible and feet planted. No furnace, no pot, no pipe or large machine baked into her layer, no ranger cape, no bow.
MIDDLE: Leia, younger dark-haired apprentice with hair tied up, short brown work coat, ivory scarf, dark apron/trousers/boots, standing in the SAME three-quarter camera facing LEFT/WEST, looking down and writing/checking a small cream paper record board in her hands. No adult ranger hood or cape, no firearm, no giant desk. This is routine checking under supervision, not final shift-handover or celebration.
RIGHT: one EMPTY low repaired wooden bench, three-quarter high view matching the scene's ground axes, warm muted brown planks, dark supports, long axis slopes gently downward to the right. No backrest. Bench roughly 1.3 times the worker's height in width, seat about half the worker's height above ground. No bowl or seated person.
Style: hard-edged genuine native pixel-art with the visual density of 48x48 character sprites and a 64x32 bench; enlarged uniform crisp square pixels in this sheet. Discrete 14-color-like palette: deep ink #111820, cold dark #1D2731 and #46515A, muted wood #5B4036 #72533E #896043 #AD7950, cloth #D3BDA0 #E9DDC3, restrained skin #B66B51 #D49776, steel #71808A. Dark contour and clearly readable tool/board silhouettes. No smooth curves, antialiasing, glow, gradient, random noise, cast ground shadows, checkerboard pixels, text, watermarks. Exactly 3 complete standalone subjects, each inside its own column, same camera and consistent human proportions; transparent gutters.
technical_key_fix: Use case: precise-object-edit. Keep all three existing subjects, their colors, shapes, clothing, proportions, positions and poses exactly unchanged. Change ONLY the checkerboard background to a perfectly solid opaque chroma-key green RGB(0,255,0) #00FF00 everywhere, including enclosed spaces inside the wrench and between bench legs. The supplied image is RGB and the checkerboard is painted, so we need this explicit flat green technical matte. No green on objects, no spill, no shading on backdrop, no checkerboard, no text. Do not crop, resize, add or remove any subject; exactly the same three columns (Mira, Leia, empty wooden bench).
